issue.title: [mailbox-experience 07/07] Trigger agent heartbeats for Inbox mail (#99)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #258

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed to branch `bb/relay-99-mailbox-experience-07-07-trigger-agent-thr_gbmjzw5n7i`.

Implements issue #99: registers a `newEmail` heartbeat on the Emails database (`onItemEvent`, `create`), dispatched through the existing `core.agentRun` action — no separate mail scheduler. A new generic `itemRelationFilter` on `core.agentRun`'s `actionConfig` gates the run on the fired item's folder relations, evaluated at fire time (after the folder-membership relation, written later in the same ingest transaction, has committed):

- Requires at least one related Folder with `specialPurpose = "inbox"`.
- Excludes the message if any related Folder has `specialPurpose` in `junk`/`trash` — including messages with multiple folder memberships (e.g. Gmail-style labels).
- Dedup for reconciliation needs no new code: `ingestEmailMessage`'s existing Message-ID convergence only calls `createItemWithClient` (the sole trigger point for the `create` event) for genuinely new messages, so a resynced/already-known message never re-fires the event.

New test file `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/newEmailHeartbeat.test.ts` covers: one event for new Inbox mail, zero for junk/trash-only mail, zero for mail in both Inbox and Junk, and no duplicate event on reconciliation of an already-known message.

Verified: full backend build (`pnpm -r run build`, 7 packages) and the complete backend test suite (16 files, 227 tests) pass.
